name: repo-consolidation
description: Account for branches, worktrees, stashes, and unfinished changes, then integrate authorized work through serial reviewed pull requests.

interface.longDescription: Complete source accounting, immutable source-to-result mapping, secure preservation, self-contained commit and review procedures, three coverage passes, and verified cleanup of eligible sources.
defaultPrompt: Inventory this repository and show work absent from its verified default branch without changing anything.
Consolidate this repository through focused commits, serial reviewed PRs, gated merges, and eligible cleanup.
